entry: Hoist limit switches adjusted; overload device tested at 110 % of rated load.
Wire rope replaced (same construction and diameter).
Re-reeved from 4 falls to 2 falls for a faster cycle; drum and gearbox unchanged. Rated load reduced to 10 t; new 2-fall hook block (300 kg).
Contactor control replaced by a frequency inverter with closed-loop hoist control (encoder on the motor). The inverter brings the hoist to standstill before it applies the brake.
Gearbox oil changed; input shaft seal replaced.

Contactor control replaced by a frequency inverter with closed-loop hoist control (encoder on the motor). The inverter brings the hoist to standstill before it applies the brake. Light-load fast lowering enabled: up to 150 % of rated speed for loads up to 50 % of rated load.
Hook and hook block inspected, no defects.

Contactor control replaced by a frequency inverter with closed-loop hoist control (encoder on the motor). The inverter brings the hoist to standstill before it applies the brake. Light-load fast lowering enabled: up to 160 % of rated speed for loads up to 40 % of rated load.
Brake linings replaced and bedded in (20 stops with rated load).
Pendant control replaced by radio remote control; functions unchanged.
Motor bearings replaced at the non-drive end.
